reviews.review: Highly recommended! Fun in day long sessions with the partner, or short bursts of light progression. easy for starting up, with many ways to customize your game play style. Not stressful, and can be a challenge once you get up to some of the highest difficulties, yet still fun! I encourage gamer couples to give this one a go. Cant wait to see heaps more content !

TL;DR Can be fun, but is plagued by a multitude of problems that will eventually dissuade players from opening the game

Fun half the time but really ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ problematic the other half, despite if you are with friends or not. Game does a decent job of fulfilling the power fantasy, allowing you to break it in multiple hilarious ways. I will also praise the game for it's art style and thematic which I love. But many aspects of Gunfire stop me completely from praising it much further:

-flawed balancing (Qing Yan is useless in mid to late reincarnation levels especially into bosses, most of Lei Luo's ascenion talents are god awful)

-poor quality of life (some translations are very vague, player characters do not have vertical animations (looking up and down) in third person)

-very slow rollout of content (we've been stuck with the same 4 zones ever since the game came out, yes 
Spiritual Assault is a new mode but it uses the same environments just with different layouts (and as of writing there is only one Assault map)

-Spiritual Assault (multiple issues with this mode that they are still adjusting, still lack of a lot of quality of life, game lags mid to late game due to number of enemies even on lowest settings, overall feels very rushed)

-outside of one or two tracks that are slightly above mediocre (Anxi Desert combat track is alright and Main Menu music is very nice imo), this game's soundtrack is just boring and generic. I think they could have leaned WAY more into the eastern thematic with the music other then "some violins and drums"

-probably my biggest issue, when you take a single large instance of damage you ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ RUBBERBAND, EVEN IN SINGLEPLAYER, infamous examples are Whale Shark's hook (as in you get hooked, try to walk away after hook wears off, and you rubberband back to the fatass who pulled you) and Sand Worm's tail slams where if you get hit once there is no way to avoid the rest, more often than not resulting in a death unless you have a lot of defensive abilities, scrolls, etc. it's pretty insulting that this has been in the game for at least a year, Duoyi is either that ignorant or just don't give enough of a ♥♥♥♥

Get this game when it gets better and is on sale, Duoyi doesn't deserve $20 for Gunfire's current state.
